integrity: Analytic finite-m proof supplied. Computational checks corroborate but do not replace proof. Historical priority provisional; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only regular Euclidean polygons and three iid uniform-arclength boundary samples; only area first and second moments and strict monotonicity of the first, plus asymptotic coefficients. No complete area distribution, no variance monotonicity, no priority certification.
title: Quartic convergence of boundary-sampled triangle areas on regular polygons
